module: Flowgraph node "Rally Loop AI Competitors Inputs" (category once_instant, tag rally). Prepares the inputs of the Rally AI Competitors Leaderboard node from the rally loop: playerTimes (raw stage times in seconds, without penalties, taken from the event log; nil from the first missing time), silverTimes (configured reference times of the linked rallyStage missions, up to 4 via stage1..4_rallyStage), stageLabels (aligned labels) and playerTotalTimeSec (official total of the loop = time + penalties). Flow pins as input and output (chainFlow).
notes: If a stage has no usable reference time (AiCompetitors.getReferenceTime), a warning is logged and the list of reference times is empty.
If the number of labels does not match the number of reference times, the labels stay empty (warning).

workOnce.desc: Initializes the outputs to empty then fills silverTimes, stageLabels, playerTotalTimeSec and playerTimes from the rally loop manager.
